question: Who among the following is the founder of the field of psychoanalysis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sigmund Freud**__.

__
 
• **Sigmund Freud is the founder of the field of psychoanalysis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Psychoanalysis**, a method of treating** mental disorders**, is shaped by **psychoanalytic theory**, which emphasizes unconscious **mental processes **and is sometimes described as **depth psychology**.

 
 
• The primary assumption of **psychoanalysis** is the belief that all people possess unconscious thoughts,** feelings, desires**, and **memories.**
 
• **Freud’s** psychoanalytic theory explains **human personality **as a series of stages that are formed through **inner conflicts**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Person Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 **Carl Jung**
 
 
 
• He was born on 26 July 1875, Kesswil, Switzerland.
 
• Carl Gustav Jung was a Swiss psychiatrist and psychoanalyst who founded analytical psychology.
 
 
 
 

 **Kai T Erikson**
 
 
 
• He was born on 12 February 1931, Vienna, Austria
 
• Kai Theodor Erikson is an Austrian-born American sociologist, noted as an authority on the social consequences of catastrophic events.
 
• He served as the 76th president of the American Sociological Association.
 
 
 
 

 **Jean Piaget**
 
 
 
• He was born on 9 August 1896, Neuchatel, Switzerland
 
• Jean William Fritz Piaget was a Swiss psychologist known for his work on child development.
